brief:
UN human rights expert Francesca Albanese addressed the controversy surrounding rapper Macklemore's Gaza activism and UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband's stance on West Bank settlements, according to Middle East Eye. She spoke with the UNAPOLOGETIC program about shifting public discourse on Israel and strategies for confronting what she characterizes as apartheid.

Albanese's comments touch on cultural figures' roles in the Palestine debate, British government policy toward illegal settlements, and broader efforts to challenge Israeli policies through international pressure and changed public opinion.

title: Albanese discusses Israel apartheid, settlements, cultural boycotts
